sources.title: 1941 Philco Radio Gallery — PT-42 and PT-44
sources.source_type: Philco Radio Historical Society model history
sources.finding: The PT-44 entry states that its chassis is identical to the PT-42 chassis.
sources.authority_note: Direct model-specific historical statement; the society is a retrospective source, not the factory document itself.

sources.title: Philco 1941 RMS Year Book
sources.finding: The factory service material explicitly labels the p.38 schematic and underside parts locator for PT-42 and PT-44 together.
sources.authority_note: Primary factory service source; preferred authority for circuit and part-callout evidence.

sources.title: Philco Transitone Compact Radios sales folder (RR0153, 1941)
sources.finding: Both entries describe a five-tube set with built-in loop aerial; the PT-44 entry promotes its walnut cabinet, while the PT-42 entry describes an inlaid walnut cabinet.
sources.authority_note: Contemporary manufacturer promotional material; useful for product identity and cabinet scope, not wiring.

sources.title: Philco Service Bulletin index, Bulletin 437 / 365
sources.finding: The August 1940 index entry lists PT-30, PT-42, PT-44, PT-49, and PT-87.
sources.availability: The online index entry has no image or PDF link for Bulletin 437.
sources.authority_note: Index metadata only; no technical content from the unlinked bulletin is inferred.

sources.title: Rider Volume 12 index for PT-42 / PT-44
sources.finding: The index lists schematic, socket, trimmers, and chassis information for PT-42/PT-44 at page 12-45.
sources.availability: The full volume endpoint was inaccessible during this review; the index is a retrieval lead, not a reviewed circuit source.

transferable_evidence: The PT-42/PT-44-labeled factory p.38 schematic may be used for PT-44 electrical tracing.
The PT-42/PT-44-labeled factory p.38 underside parts locator may be used for qualitative PT-44 component location.
The PT-42/PT-44-labeled factory alignment information may be used within its printed operating and measurement limits.
model_specific_limits: The chassis identity statement does not establish that the cabinets, trim, external aerial hardware, exact replacement part numbers, or every speaker assembly detail are identical.
The sales folder establishes that the PT-42 and PT-44 both have a built-in loop aerial, but does not prove identical loop part numbers, winding parameters, terminals, or mounting details.
No RF net memberships, winding endpoint assignments, 7A8 socket-pin assignments, or physical game coordinates are added by this review.

engineering_consequence.next_step: Continue tracing the lower loop and #2 aerial-transformer winding, external antenna contact, #4 oscillator gang and #10 oscillator transformer. The v0.41 input trace resolves only the signal-side branch and explicit loop-mode grounds; promote further memberships only when directly source-backed.
